subject: [PATCH v2] fs/fcntl: fix SOFTIRQ-unsafe lock order in fasync signaling

reviews.author: Jeff Layton
reviews.summary: Identified that the rcu_read_lock() isn't sufficient to stabilize the do_each_pid_task() walk, suggesting reverting the patch until further investigation.

reviews.author: Oleg Nesterov
reviews.summary: Agreed to revert the patch and pointed out another potential issue with the 'if (type <= PIDTYPE_TGID)' case in send_sigio/send_sigurg.
reviews.raw_body:
On 10/12, Jeff Layton wrote:
>
> We probably should
> revert this patch for now, until the problem and potential solution are
> more clear.

Agreed... I'll send the revert for now.

Hmm. The "if (type <= PIDTYPE_TGID)" case in send_sigio/send_sigurg looks
wrong too. send_sigio_to_task() -> ... -> lock_task_sighand() can fail if
we race with de_thread().

Oleg.

2026-10-12.patch_summary: The patch aims to fix a SOFTIRQ-unsafe lock order in fasync signaling, but it has been identified as having issues and is being reverted.
